description: Implementation of the DisplayVkXcb class for Vulkan XCB surface handling, including connection management, window validation, configuration generation, and extension support.

classes.name: DisplayVkXcb
classes.description: Class managing Vulkan XCB display connection, configuration, and surface creation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the XCB connection for the display.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Closes the XCB connection and cleans up.

methods.name: isValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Checks if a native window handle is valid by querying XCB.

methods.name: createWindowSurfaceVk
methods.description: Creates a Vulkan window surface for the given window.

methods.name: generateConfigs
methods.description: Generates display configurations with specific color formats.

methods.name: checkConfigSupport
methods.description: Checks if a given configuration is supported, setting visual IDs.

methods.name: getWSIExtension
methods.description: Returns the Vulkan extension name for XCB surface support.
